args.summary: Who led the league in STL per game in each season from 2017 to 2020 (end-years)? Name each season's leader and his average.

final_answer:
This data covers the 2017 to 2020 seasons.
Based on league historical leaders data, the STL leaders were:
2017: Draymond Green, 2.0
2018: Victor Oladipo, 2.4
2019: Paul George, 2.2
2020: Ben Simmons, 2.1

args.summary: Who led the league in AST per game in each season from 2017 to 2018 (end-years)? Name each season's leader and his average.

final_answer:
The data covers the 2017 to 2018 seasons.

James Harden led in 2017 with 11.2 assists per game.
Russell Westbrook led in 2018 with 10.3 assists per game.
